input.body: We are writing to request a review of a deduction on order DD-51131 from 2026-11-06. The amount deducted was $19.00, and the reason given was "wrong item" for Chicken Momo (Steamed). The order ticket for DD-51131 lists "Chicken Momo (Steamed)" [DD-51131:ticket_lists_item]. This shows the order was entered with that item as placed. Our records show the order was ready at 19:31 and picked up at 19:34, three minutes later [DD-51131:pickup_handoff]. We are not claiming anything beyond these records, which do not show the contents of the bag. Based on the ticket and the pickup timing, we respectfully ask that you review this deduction and reverse it. Thank you for your time and consideration.
